node.statement: After first fixing one global witness package W_RF supplied by lem-routef-raw-factor-setting-formation, for every input (H,Phi,eta) to which that formation result applies, fix one def-routef-raw-factor-setting datum S over that same W_RF supplied by the same result, for every Delta' supplied for (W_RF,S) by lem-routef-delta-prime-closeness, and every Delta supplied from that same Delta' by lem-routef-delta-normalization-closeness; for every integer n >= 1 and all X, Y in M_n(S.B), writing the fields of (W_RF,S) as the unqualified symbols below: Route F degree-two estimate: with C_2 := C_Delta'+4*C_Delta and rho_2 := min{rho_prod, rho_Delta', rho_Delta}, for 0 <= eta <= rho_2, every amplification satisfies ||Phi_n(Delta_n X Delta_n Y) - Delta_n(XY)|| <= C_2*eta*||X||*||Y||.
